title: The website editor's Theme tab edits the shared site style (Frequency or Bold and the four global styles), and every editor document draws through the theme's sections

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-10-11 ('All sites should be templated with rails and global styles and edits') with the 2026-10-12 answer 'edit in both places, one setting'. ADR-1729

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-12. The Theme tab offers Frequency and Bold (DAWN and Menswork on the draft); Midnight is retired with a note. Picking a theme or a global style saves preferences.siteStyle live via saveWebsiteStyle, guarded on the draft revision against the editor's own autosave. The canvas wears the global styles and the footer choice; WebsiteDocument draws every theme through the site page sections; the live site takes its theme from the shared style alone. A Frequency editor publish stays off the live site under LIVE-892 until the owner checks the preview.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const miss=[];const sh=r('components/sites/editor/shell.tsx');if(!/SITE_THEMES\.map\(\(t\) => \{ const theme = EDITOR_THEME\[t\.id\]/.test(sh))miss.push('the editor still offers its own themes');if(!/Global styles/.test(sh))miss.push('the editor has no global styles');if(!/export async function saveWebsiteStyle/.test(r('lib/sites/editor/actions.ts')))miss.push('the editor cannot save the shared style');const wd=r('components/sites/website-document.tsx');if(/blocks\.map\(\(block, i\) => wrap\(<BlockRender/.test(wd))miss.push('a non-Bold document still renders bare blocks');if(!/const boldSite = siteStyle\.theme === 'bold'/.test(r('components/sites/site-page.tsx')))miss.push('the live theme is not the shared style');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-896: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
